technique_name: Analyze two recent news articles about Apple's iPhone to find qualitative differences between the two.
description: The two articles discuss various features that could be added or improved on the upcoming iPhone 13.  The first article mentions that the new phone could include a larger display as well as 5G connectivity. It also suggests that Apple may be focusing on battery life and performance more than ever before.
